description: "A Letter of Affectionate Remonstrance Addressed to the Members of the Established Church" by John Alexander is a religious pamphlet written during the early 19th century. It serves as a critical appeal to the members of the Established Church regarding the exclusivity of a proposed infant education system in Norwich.
